model_annotation: The two line plots display the variation of the variable BLEU with respect to two different parameters, α and ρ, respectively. Both plots share a common vertical axis labeled "BLEU," which ranges from 28.0 to 28.5 with a linear scale and a tick interval of 0.1. The left plot shows the BLEU score as a function of α, with the horizontal axis ranging from 0.1 to 0.9 on a linear scale and marked at intervals of 0.2. The data points, represented by light blue circles connected by a light blue line, start at a BLEU value of 28.0 when α is 0.1, increase to a peak of 28.5 at α = 0.5, and then decrease to 28.1 at α = 0.9. The right plot shows the BLEU score as a function of ρ, with the horizontal axis ranging from 0.05 to 0.45 on a linear scale and marked at intervals of 0.15. The data points, also represented by light blue circles connected by a light blue line, begin at a BLEU value of 28.3 when ρ is 0.05, rise to a peak of 28.5 at ρ = 0.15, then decrease to 28.4 at ρ = 0.25, increase again to 28.45 at ρ = 0.35, and finally decrease slightly to 28.4 at ρ = 0.45.
